summary: Full-stack testing of the real AzuraCast integration (replacing the demo somafm stream). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_radio_azuracast.py — GET /api/live/status returns the full expected shape (is_live, is_online, title, artist, album, artwork, listeners, stream_url, refresh_interval, station_name) with the LIVE song title ('musica 3') fetched from the AzuraCast Now Playing API server-side + station_name 'Pescatori di Uomini' + refresh_interval=15; GET /api/live/stream returns 503 (NOT 500 or hang) when the AzuraCast mount is offline (502 upstream) — verified with 25s timeout, connection closed cleanly; GET /api/live/art returns 400 for non-http URLs and 503 for unreachable hosts; GET /api/admin/radio returns 401 unauthenticated, 200 with admin token; PUT /api/admin/radio with refresh_interval=20 persists and is immediately reflected in /api/live/status; PUT /api/admin/radio with a new stream_url is picked up dynamically by /api/live/stream (proves no code change needed); non-admin listener account gets 403 on both GET and PUT /api/admin/radio; regression: /api/podcasts, /api/news, /api/products, /api/programs all 200; /api/auth/register + /api/auth/me still work. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Home (guest) shows 'IN DIRETTA ORA' badge + 'ORA IN ONDA' label + LIVE song title 'musica 3' + station 'Pescatori di Uomini' — real AzuraCast metadata rendered end-to-end via the polling PlayerContext; tapping 'Ascolta la Diretta' does NOT crash the app even though the MP3 stream 503s — button correctly toggles to 'In riproduzione' with pause icon and the mini-player appears at the bottom; PlayerContext handles the 503 via its reconnect state machine (browser emits a benign 'source not found' event which is caught). Admin login (pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it / Admin1234!) redirects to /admin. /admin/radio renders ALL required fields with testIDs: radio-live (switch), radio-station, radio-stream, radio-backup, radio-metadata, radio-refresh, radio-title, radio-artist, radio-artwork, radio-save; entering 25 in refresh, tapping Salva shows 'Impostazioni radio salvate ✓' and after page reload the field correctly displays 25 (persisted); restored to 15 for cleanup. All 9 review-request acceptance items verified.

critical_code_review_comments: /api/live/status uses a broad try/except around httpx.get and always returns a stable shape (never raises) — perfect for offline resilience. It correctly maps AzuraCast 'now_playing.song.title/artist/art' + 'listeners.current' + honors live.streamer_name when a DJ is on air.

/api/live/stream builds an httpx AsyncClient with follow_redirects=True, closes upstream + client on non-200 and on generator finally-block. No resource leaks, no server hang under offline conditions (verified with 25s timeout).
/api/live/art restricts to http(s) URLs and follows redirects — appropriate for AzuraCast's dynamic art endpoints.
PUT /api/admin/radio uses upsert on live_status _id='current' — enables dynamic changes with no code modification. Confirmed /api/live/stream reads the DB value on each request (no in-memory cache).

Frontend PlayerContext polls metadata every liveInfo.refresh_interval s (min 5s), updates the live track in place without restarting audio — clean stale-closure avoidance via trackRef/shouldPlayLiveRef.

Reconnection state machine: playbackStatusUpdate listener detects stream drops when isLive && shouldPlayLive && !playing && !isBuffering → schedules attemptReconnect with backoff (1.5s → 4s → 4s → 4s → 10s). connection state exposed to UI as 'online'|'reconnecting'|'offline'. Sound design.
api.liveStatus() rewrites http-only artwork to the HTTPS /api/live/art proxy — prevents mixed-content on web. Good.
startup() migrates any leftover somafm/demo stream_url to AZ_STREAM_URL — safe rollout.
admin/radio.tsx clamps refresh_interval to max(5, int) before submission — matches server side which defaults 15 when unset.
